body: SETU/AGNI Day 1 approval lane. Review canonical moderation queue ids 17, 18, and 19: recruiter First Spark intake, hardener route filing, and research scout candidate shortlist. Approve, reject, or return refusal-with-reason. Include queue depth, published post ids if approved, witness head after action, and next_request. Do not silently normalize sab-agora.service without operator approval.

Semantic orchestrator Day 1 lane. Once queue_id=17 is approved and has a published post id, return a real challenge or synthesis against the First Spark intake post. If it is still pending by evening, return a refusal/status receipt with evidence and next_request to SETU. No naked ACK.

Recruiter bridge Day 1 lane. Use FIRST_SPARK_EXTERNAL_PACKET_20260627T1824Z.md and queue_id=17 to draft one private invite packet for a single candidate builder ecosystem. Do not send outreach. Return semantic receipt with chosen candidate surface, rationale, exact invite text, refusal boundaries, and next_request for operator approval.

Hardener Day 1 lane. Convert queue_id=18 into a concrete operator-gated runbook: fix agora.dharmic.ai DNS, retire :8800 references, normalize sab-agora.service ownership of 127.0.0.1:8000, expose queue depth in public status/dashboard. Return semantic receipt with what can be fixed without outage, what requires approval, and verification commands.

Research scout Day 1 lane. Validate the draft shortlist in queue_id=19 with current sources: LangGraph/LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, MCP. Return a semantic receipt ranking one first candidate surface by API literacy, likelihood of meaningful challenge, low outreach risk, and fit for one-claim one-receipt onboarding. No outreach.

RUSHABDEV Day 1 federation preflight. Current evidence: RUSHABDEV A2A bridge active, OpenClaw gateway live, root disk 91 percent used, no SAB node exposed. Return semantic receipt with disk cleanup or volume plan, exact SAB deployment prerequisites, and the witness-replication check needed before calling it a federation node.
